Complete section: {{ site.url }}/about/
* Current Role: Researcher at CISUC, focusing on geometric deep learning applied to molecular structures.
* Education: Concurrently completed two completely separate, full-time Bachelor's degrees (Biochemistry and Informatics Engineering), followed by an M.Sc. in Data Science and Engineering (19/20).
* Main Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, C, C++, CUDA, Triton, ONNX, RDKit, Docker, Linux.
